scope: Recorded local results, not a fresh CI run or proof of complete engine reconstruction. Generated evidence and the game binary are excluded.

elf32_integer.scope: Original isolated self-contained arithmetic bodies with their original stack ABI, Python golden values and Linux i386 entry/IO. Not a Windows runtime, whole-game trace, native zero-divisor test, register/stack post-state test or universal equivalence proof.

pe32_wine_integer.scope: Original isolated position-independent arithmetic bodies copied to RX memory in a PE32 process under Wine; golden results generated with Python integers. No whole-game runtime, zero-divisor native exception, caller fixed-point scaling or universal equivalence claim.

pe32_wine_pop_lifetime.scope: Original code with PE HIGHLOW loader relocations in a private reference-image mapping, no engine entry/TLS/init. Synthetic HeapAlloc nodes and 0..3 RTTI-linked CRegiment fixtures; absent registries, global state +0xd1d=1 and +0xd1c=0, null regiment +0x74. Also standalone registry first-key removal and deregistration with controlled live tables. Includes insertion, five explicit-key and 36 automatic-ID registered-POP lifecycles with empty owned containers. Three isolated original-lock cases include controlled worker-thread contention and real SwitchToThread. Real successful HeapAlloc/HeapFree forwarded by recording IAT callbacks; native FS:0 restored. No failure paths, live game objects, country/type bookkeeping, army callbacks, parallel registry mutation, duplicate-key error or exception unwinding tested.

pe32_wine_float_conversion.scope: Original 171-byte conversion block with two PE HIGHLOW relocations, binary64 and canonical extended80 inputs loaded into ST(0), all exceptions masked, precision-control 64-bit, four x87/MXCSR rounding modes, selector zero/one, three entries. Host FPU state saved/restored. Rational model includes directed binary64 quantization and initial FISTP rounding/range. No whole POP update, all possible extended inputs/encodings, unmasked exception, other precision control or universal ABI/equivalence proof.
